name: Grammarly
tagline: Writing assistant for grammar, clarity, tone, and everyday editing.

limits: Not a full SEO strategy tool
Suggestions may flatten a distinctive voice

name: Jasper
tagline: Marketing-focused AI platform for campaign copy, brand voice, and team workflows.

name: Copy.ai
tagline: AI workflow platform for sales, marketing, and go-to-market tasks.

limits: Requires workflow design to be useful

Search data must be interpreted carefully

tagline: Paraphrasing, summarizing, grammar, and citation tools for students and writers.

May change meaning if used carelessly

limits: Commercial use depends on plan terms

name: ElevenLabs
tagline: AI voice generation, dubbing, and audio production platform.
